about.description: 0xequity is a fractional real-estate tokenization platform established in 2023, operated through 0xequity Corp (British Virgin Islands) and 0xequity US, Inc. (Wilmington, Delaware), with teams based in the United States and Turkey. KYC-verified users buy property tokens from $10, receive a share of net rental income claimable on-chain, and can use tokens in DeFi features such as collateralized borrowing on Base and Arbitrum. The operator states it is not a registered broker-dealer or investment adviser, discloses no securities licenses, and prohibits U.S. citizens from investing.
about.registryInfo: 0xequity is the operator of a permissioned real estate tokenization platform. Each property is held by a dedicated Delaware LLC special purpose vehicle where approximately 90 to 95 percent of equity is tokenized as an ERC-20 with 0 decimals on Base. The 158 Nelson St SPV file number is not publicly disclosed and the parent 0xequity operating jurisdiction is not stated in the documentation. Regulatory positioning is consistent with a Regulation S style offshore private offering (US persons and sanctioned jurisdictions are excluded and both minting and holding require KYC and AML allowlisting) but no Reg D, Reg S, EU prospectus, DIFC, or VARA registration is explicitly cited. Contact via asimashfaq@0xequity.com.
about.regulatoryStatus: No licenses or registrations disclosed. Site disclaimer states the operator is not a registered broker-dealer or investment advisor and that U.S. citizens are not permitted to invest.
about.keyMilestones: 2023: 0xequity established | 2026-Q4: planned launch of tokenized US stocks with DeFi integration (per official site)
about.entityStructureNotes: 0xequity Corp, Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands; 0xequity US, Inc., Wilmington, Delaware. Homepage footer names 0xequity Corp as operator while the About page names 0xequity US, Inc.; company describes itself as primarily based in the United States and Turkey.

fees.revenueModel: Hybrid - rental income fee, property listing fees, purchase-time operating expense; no buy/sell fees currently
fees.revenueNotes: Footer disclosure: no fees on buy/sell (subject to change), 2% fee on rental income, per-property listing fees, a 2% monthly fee and a 10% purchase-time operating expense; 10% of rental income goes to property managers. Disclosures are inconsistently worded across pages and the incidence of the monthly/operating charges is unclear.
fees.revenueVerificationMethod: Official website footer disclosures (homepage and About page) and docs.0xequity.com
